image_alt: A whippet in a red collar lies on the grass on a lead beside a wide river under a blue sky.

text.facebook: Since 1 November, owners of banned breed dogs in England and Wales, including XL Bullies, must not leave a child under 12 in close contact with their dog at home or in the garden without an adult present. Cameras and baby monitors don't count. PDSA says any dog, whatever the breed, can pose a risk in some circumstances. My tip: give your dog a quiet spot children know to leave alone. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/banned-breeds-and-children
